summary: StaffMessageService is a web service class that provides operations to retrieve staff messages by ID. It exposes a single web method that returns the message text for a given staff message ID and session hash.
purpose: To allow retrieval of staff message text based on staff message ID and user session, facilitating access to staff communications within the system.

fields.name: sessionHash
fields.description: Hash representing the user's session used to identify the session context.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier of the staff message to retrieve.

workflows.name: Get Staff Message By ID
steps: User calls StaffMessageGetByID web method with sessionHash and message ID.
System converts sessionHash to sessionID using HSPnetSession.GetSessionIDFromHash.
System searches for staff message matching sessionID and ID via StaffMessages.StaffMessagesSearchID.
If found, returns msg.Message (staff message text).
If not found, returns empty string.

business_rules: Only retrieve staff message if valid session hash is provided.
Return empty string if staff message not found for session and ID.
validations: sessionHash must be valid and convertible to sessionID.
id must correspond to an existing staff message.
conditions: msg != null: message exists for provided session and ID.
else: message does not exist, return empty string.
system_behavior: Buffers web method response, caches result for 60 seconds.
Web method accessible as a SOAP service with BasicProfile1_1 conformance.
exceptions: If sessionHash is invalid or not convertible, message lookup may fail.
If staff message not found, returns empty string.
No explicit error handling exposed to consumer.
content_gaps: No details on input validation for sessionHash or id.
No information about logging, security, or error handling beyond empty string response.
Only one web method defined; additional functionality (e.g., create/update/delete messages) is not described.
